attempts.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.file_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py' AND s.kind = 'class' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id) ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
Which classes defined in httpx/_exceptions.py are not subclassed by any other class anywhere in the repository (tests included)? Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Selects class symbols defined in httpx/_exceptions.py and excludes any that appear as a base_symbol_id in code.class_bases, meaning no other class in the repository (including tests) subclasses them. Returns the remaining symbol IDs.
sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.file_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py' AND s.kind = 'class' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id) ORDER BY s.symbol_id
